code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (O₂ saturation, pO₂, and pH markedly low), pancytopenia (low leukocytes, lymphocytes, platelets, hemoglobin), elevated RDW, ferritin, LDH, INR, and mild CRP elevation. These findings suggest acute severe respiratory failure with possible sepsis or systemic inflammatory response, coagulopathy, and multi-lineage cytopenias. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are warranted.
